items.title: NMDOT FFY 2023-2024 Planning Work Program
items.description: Establishes NMDOT's two-year federally funded planning and research program for FFY 2023 and 2024, covering multimodal planning, data management, research, MPO work programs, RTPO work programs, budgets, schedules, and Federal Highway Administration reimbursement.

items.description: Records the first FHWA/FTA-approved amendment to NMDOT's FFY 2023-2024 planning program, removing obsolete LTAP references and adding PROTECT planning work to the narrative while preserving the original federal planning-program record.
